title: Tilley T3 Classic Hat (Navy or Khaki, select sizes)

comparisons.notes: Same Tilley T3 Classic hat, Khaki in sizes 6 7/8 to 8 in stock at $99 on tilley.com.

writeup: Tilley's T3 Classic, the Canadian-made cotton hat with UPF 50+ sun protection, a water-repellent finish and a hydrofil sweatband, is $33.99 new on Woot in Navy or Khaki. Tilley's own store sells the T3 Classic for $99. Sizes are limited (6 7/8 to 7 5/8) and Woot caps it at 3 per customer.
